= Customizing WGL5 =

WGL5 gives the user the option to customize his WGL installation smoothly via the @wgl5 mod folder. The idea is to offer certain options to the user over an official system, so that there is the ability to customize WGL up to a certain point while keeping standardization easy for league play.
